open_questions: The Novellara letter of 3 April 1501 describes a cartoon; text and archival reference to check in Villata 1999.
Is the cartoon Vasari describes the one in the Novellara letter, and how does it relate to w-burlington (now dated c.1506 to 1508 by the National Gallery)?
